entries.title: Phase 5 — Video-to-quote AI, Marketplace, Cost Intelligence, White-label
entries.detail:
Video-to-Quote Pipeline:
- Presigned R2 upload for video files (500MB cap, 15min TTL)
- Frame extraction worker dispatch (Railway service, AWS Batch in Phase 6)
- Claude Vision analysis of up to 20 keyframes — rooms identified, condition notes,
  per-line-item confidence levels, flagged issues, recommended follow-up
- Secure frame-extraction webhook receiver (shared secret auth)
- Full job lifecycle: uploading → extracting → analyzing → complete/failed

Cost Intelligence Engine:
- Historical benchmark queries (P25/avg/P75 contract value per project type)
- Quote audit: flags quotes >40% above/below tenant's own historical average
- AI margin report (Haiku) — natural language executive summary per period

Marketplace (multi-firm lead routing):
- Seller side: list overflow leads with AI-generated PII-free summary, set price
- Buyer side: browse available leads by city/type/price, claim via Stripe payment
- Platform commission (10%) via Stripe Connect application_fee_amount
- Contact info released only after payment confirmed via webhook
- Lead TTL: 72h auto-expiry (pg_cron snippet in migration)
- Revenue tracking: leads sold, gross/net revenue per origin tenant

White-label (Enterprise):
- Custom domain, brand name, primary color, logo, favicon, custom CSS
- hideBuiltWith flag, supportEmail override
- brandTokens endpoint for CSS variable injection
- Gated behind assertFeatureAccess("white_label") → Enterprise plan only

DB Phase 5 schema + migration:
- marketplace_profiles, marketplace_leads, lead_purchases
- video_quote_jobs (with RLS)
- whitelabel_configs
- Grants + pg_cron lead expiry snippet

Co-Authored-By: Michael Gord <michael@gda.capital>

entries.title: Phase 4 — Stripe SaaS billing + Connect + tenant onboarding
entries.detail:
Stripe SaaS Billing:
- Three plans: Starter ($99), Growth ($299), Enterprise ($999/mo)
- Checkout session creation with 14-day trial
- Customer Portal for self-serve plan changes / cancellation
- Webhook handler: checkout.session.completed, subscription.updated/deleted, payment_failed
- Plan auto-synced to tenant.plan on every subscription event

Plan Gating:
- assertUserLimit / assertProjectLimit / assertAiQuoteLimit per plan
- assertFeatureAccess gates content machine, referrals, loyalty, marketing, inventory, white-label

Stripe Connect:
- Per-tenant Connect account (standard) for collecting customer payments
- Onboarding link generation, payment intent creation on connected accounts

Tenant Onboarding:
- 5-step checklist: profile → plan → payments → social
- Team invite flow (FlashyID-backed, placeholder user record claimed on first login)
- Plan comparison endpoint with feature lists
- Save social credentials (Meta + Google) to tenant_settings

UI:
- /onboarding checklist page with progress bar
- /settings/billing page with current plan + upgrade/downgrade cards

DB Migration 0001:
- stripe_connect_account_id + stripe_connect_onboarded on tenant_settings
- RLS policy for tenant_settings
- Indexes on stripe_subscription_id + stripe_customer_id

Co-Authored-By: Michael Gord <michael@gda.capital>

entries.title: Phase 2/3 — Content Machine, Referrals, Loyalty, Marketing, Inventory, Quotes
entries.detail:
Content Machine:
- Case study generator (Claude Opus Vision) — title, scope, outcome, FAQ, 3 social posts, SEO meta
- Social scheduler with Meta Graph API (Instagram + Facebook) and Google My Business
- Media router with presigned R2 uploads, AI caption generation (Haiku), publish flags

Referral Engine:
- Create/convert/reward flow with tiered rewards ($250/$500/$1000 by project value)
- Auto loyalty points on referral conversion, referrer email notifications via Resend

Loyalty Program:
- Points per $100 spent, review bonuses, repeat customer bonus
- 4-tier system (bronze/silver/gold/platinum) with tier-specific benefits
- Points redemption ($25 off per 100 pts)

Marketing Automation:
- 3-step nurture email sequence
- Post-completion review request sequence
- AI win-back message generator (Haiku) for cold leads
- 5 contact segments: repeat buyers, high-value, inactive 6m, nurture leads, gold tier

Inventory Management:
- Stock items with reorder points, per-unit cost tracking
- In/out/adjustment transactions linked to projects
- Low-stock alerts and reorder suggestions

Quotes:
- Edit AI-generated drafts, send via email (Resend), accepted status auto-updates lead to won

DB Phase 2 schema:

entries.title: scaffold Phase 1 — CRM, Project Hub, AI quote pipeline
entries.detail:
Build OS monorepo bootstrapped under /buildos:
- Turborepo workspace with apps/web (Next.js 15) and packages/db + types
- FlashyID as OIDC OAuth provider via Auth.js v5 custom provider
  - Auto-provisions tenant from FlashyID org_id/buildos_tenant claim
  - Upserts user record on every sign-in, stores flashy_id as subject ref
- PostgreSQL schema via Drizzle ORM with Row-Level Security
  - All tenant-scoped tables enforce RLS via app.current_tenant_id session var
  - withTenant() helper sets the var per transaction
  - Separate migrator role (BYPASSRLS) vs app role (RLS enforced)
- tRPC v11 routers: leads, contacts, projects, ai
  - Role-gated procedures (viewer/field/manager/admin/owner)
  - Lead pipeline aggregation, contact loyalty points, project financials
- AI photo-to-quote pipeline using Claude Vision (claude-opus-5)
  - Accepts 1–10 photos, returns structured line-item quote as draft
  - Haiku-backed caption generator for before/after media
- Dashboard KPI page (SSR server-side caller)
- Sidebar navigation with all 9 modules pre-wired
- Tailwind dark theme (gray-950 ground, teal-400 accent)

Co-Authored-By: Michael Gord <michael@gda.capital>

entries.title: Fix mobile drawer on all 691 pages: CSS injection and z-index
entries.detail:
Two bugs diagnosed from mobile screenshots:
1. 287 newly generated pages had drawer HTML but no mobile CSS (injection
   script couldn't match minified CSS string) — drawer items rendered
   inline, hamburger button was a grey square, accordion didn't work
2. All pages had mob-drawer z-index:200 equal to mega-menu dropdown,
   and homepage drawer was z-index:60 (below the sticky nav at z-index:50
   was barely above it) — drawer was obscured by the sticky nav bar

Fix: inject full mobile CSS into all pages missing it, bump mob-drawer
z-index to 300 site-wide, homepage drawer z-index 60→300. Add
display:block !important on .mob-group-body a to prevent cascade override.

entries.title: Fix dropdown positioning and hover-gap click bug on all pages
entries.detail:
Two bugs:
1. Homepage missing .nav-drop{position:relative} — dropdowns were anchoring
   to the header instead of their trigger, placing Markets and Resources at
   the far right of the page.
2. top:calc(100%+14px) created a 14px gap between trigger and dropdown;
   moving the mouse across the gap lost hover state, making items unclickable.
   Fixed with a .nav-drop::after pseudo-element that bridges the gap invisibly.

Applied to homepage + all 411 interior pages.
